title: Restriction and set difference decomposition
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J,S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite sets. The elements of $S$ that lie in $J$, lifted back to the ambient set, together with the elements of $S$ outside $J$, form exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ and $S$ are finite subsets of the $n$-element set
